title: Supplier Price-List Sync
summary: Shops and wholesalers update hundreds of prices by hand from messy supplier PDFs. AI matches products and shows the changes.
hook: "Supplier sent a new 40-page PDF price list. Someone has to update 1,200 products by hand… again."
story:
**Rachel runs an online shop with 3,000 products from 15 suppliers.** Every month, suppliers send new price lists, each in a different format: PDF, Excel with merged cells, or prices pasted into the email body. Her assistant spends **2–3 days a month** finding each product and updating cost and selling prices.

Last quarter one supplier raised prices by 12% and they **missed it for 3 weeks**, selling 200 orders at almost no margin.

whyReal.title: Happens every month
whyReal.text: Suppliers update prices regularly, more often when inflation or exchange rates move.

whyReal.title: Mistakes cost real money
whyReal.text: A missed price increase means selling at a loss; a typo can mean a disastrous price.

whyReal.title: Messy formats, ideal for AI
whyReal.text: Matching "BOSCH GSR 18V-55 2x2Ah" to your SKU "Bosch drill 18V 55Nm kit" is exactly what LLMs are now good at.

whyReal.title: But: buyers are spread out
whyReal.text: Many small shops, so we need a good channel (e.g. a Shopify/WooCommerce app store listing).

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: online shops and small wholesalers/distributors with 500+ products and 5+ suppliers.

whoPays.label: Market
whoPays.text: global, via Shopify / WooCommerce app stores, plus direct sales to distributors.

solution.title: Upload
solution.text: drop in the supplier's file (PDF, Excel, CSV) or forward the email.

solution.title: Read
solution.text: AI extracts every product line: name, code, price, unit.

solution.title: Match
solution.text: each line is matched to your existing products, with a confidence score. New products are flagged.

solution.title: Review changes
solution.text: "43 prices up (avg +8%), 5 down, 12 new products, 3 discontinued". Approve all or one by one.

solution.title: Margin rules
solution.text: selling prices update automatically using your margin rules (e.g. cost × 1.35, round to .99).

solution.title: Sync
solution.text: push updates to Shopify / WooCommerce / Excel export.

must: Shopify or WooCommerce sync (one platform first)
later: Stock level updates from supplier files

timeline.what: **Validate.** Collect 10 real supplier price lists from shops; we do the matching by hand with AI scripts and send them the result.
Margin rules, Shopify/WooCommerce sync, first paying shops.

competitors.name: PIM tools (e.g. Plytix, Akeneo)
competitors.gap: Heavy setup, not focused on messy supplier PDFs

competitors.name: Generic import apps (CSV importers)
competitors.gap: Need clean files; no AI matching

competitors.name: Us
competitors.what: Messy file in → reviewed price changes out

risks.answer: Always show changes for approval; never auto-publish low-confidence matches.
Use app stores for distribution; content marketing ("how to update supplier prices").
That's exactly why AI beats fixed import templates.
Volume play; keep onboarding fully self-serve.

questions: How many suppliers and products do you have?
How often do suppliers send new price lists, and in what format?
How many hours does updating them take each month? Who does it?
Have you ever sold at the wrong price because of a missed update? What did it cost?
Which shop platform or ERP do you use?
